```{r}
srt_sub2 <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5 == "2")

srt_sub2 <- find_neighbors_clusters(srt_sub2,
                               dims_i    = 1:50,
                               ref_assay = "SCT",
                               k         = 30,
                               res       = c(0.2,0.5))

srt_sub2 <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt_sub2,
                  n.neighbors    = 30,
                  nn.name        = Seurat::Neighbors(srt_sub),
                  reduction.name = "umap",
                  return.model   = FALSE)

```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(srt_sub2,c("Igf1","Glis1", "Csf3"), order = TRUE,reduction = "umap")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
DimPlot(srt_sub2, label = TRUE,reduction = "umap",split.by = "sample.name")
```

```{r}
x <- FindAllMarkers(srt_sub2)
```

```{r}
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5 == "2")

srt_sub <- process_all_cc(srt_sub,
                  ref_assay     = proc_params$ref_assay,
                  dims_i        = seq(proc_params$n_pca_dims),
                  k             = proc_params$k_neighbors,
                  res           = c(0.2,0.5),
                  n_features    = proc_params$n_features,
                  k.nn          = proc_params$n_umap_neighbors,
                  exclude_genes = excluded_genes)

```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(srt_sub,c("Igf1","Glis1", "Csf3"), order = TRUE,reduction = "umap.nn")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
pos     <- Embeddings(srt_sub, "pca.SCT")[, 1:10]
genes   <- VariableFeatures(srt_sub2)
genes <- c(genes, "Igf1", "Meg3")
data    <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(srt_sub, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[genes, ])
res     <- Seurat::RunMoransI(data = data, pos = pos)
x <- tibble::tibble(
  gene      = rownames(res),
  morans_i  = res$observed,
  p_value   = res$p.value,
  p_adj     = p.adjust(res$p.value, method = "BH"),
) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(morans_i))

```
